name: The Captain of the American Ship
summary: The captain of an American ship who rescued the narrator's boat in mid-ocean and brought him to a hospital in San Francisco.
description: This unnamed captain commanded the American ship that picked up the narrator's small boat adrift in mid-ocean. He subsequently brought the delirious narrator to a hospital in San Francisco, where he was treated.

sources.quote: brought thither by the captain of the American ship which had picked up my boat in mid-ocean

facts: He picked up the narrator's boat in mid-ocean.
He brought the narrator to a San Francisco hospital.
